title: Deck Strategy Plan (one strategy record per slide)
description: Local-only deck strategy plan: one strategy record per slide, sitting between the deck outline and per-slide artwork. Each record names the slide's core_message, page_type, the editable visual_structure archetype it should use, optional key_metrics, and an image_need that is biased toward editable structures. The plan is the main quality path for turning a business source into a strong deck — generated images are AUXILIARY. It embeds no raw source body text and triggers no image generation, D-One, model API, public network, or telemetry. The image_need enum has no 'required' value, so a generated image is never mandatory at the contract layer. Producers that derive a STARTER plan from headings (scripts/init_strategy_plan.py) keep most slides at image_need 'none'. Schema-level checks are complemented by the semantic cross-checks in scripts/validate_strategy_layer.py (slide_count == len(slides); slide_index unique AND contiguous 1..N). This schema uses only the JSON Schema keyword subset that scripts/validate_artifacts.py implements. See references/strategy-and-style-layer.md.

schema_version.description: Plan-file schema version. Locked to '1'; bumped only with a paired emitter + schema change.

plan_id.description: Self-describing record identifier so a reader scanning mixed JSON evidence recognises this plan.

boundary.description: Fixed framing that this is a local-only strategy plan with no raw source body text, no image generation, and no D-One / model API / public network / telemetry, and that generated images are auxiliary to editable structures.

deck_title.description: Deck title. Capped at the operator contract's slide_title limit.

slide_count.description: Planned slide count; must equal len(slides). The equality is enforced by scripts/validate_strategy_layer.py (the schema subset cannot express it).

slides.description: One strategy record per slide, in slide order. slide_index values must be unique AND contiguous 1..N (checked by scripts/validate_strategy_layer.py).

slide_index.description: 1-based slide index, unique and contiguous in slide order.

slide_title.description: Human-readable slide title. Capped at the operator contract's slide_title limit.

core_message.description: The single point this slide must land — the takeaway a reader should leave with. Author-supplied or a heading-derived starter seed; never raw source body text.

page_type.description: Closed enum for the page's narrative role.

key_metrics.description: Optional headline metrics this slide should foreground as editable KPI / table content. Omitted (or empty) when no metric is being foregrounded; a heading-derived starter leaves this out.

visual_structure.description: The editable visual structure this slide should be built from. Shares the exact vocabulary used by style_profile.layout_archetypes. Every value is realisable from the controlled render primitives (text / shapes / lines / tables / KPI blocks) without a generated image.

image_need.description: How much a generated image would help THIS slide. There is intentionally NO 'required' value: a generated image is never mandatory. Most business slides should be 'none' and rely on the editable visual_structure; reserve 'recommended' for the rare slide (e.g. a cover hero) where an image genuinely earns its place.
